concurrencyAndStop: Business locks, immutable one-predecessor uniqueness and head compare-and-swap are the reviewed serialization design. Stop/revocation and exact scoped keys still govern new sends; native race outcomes remain a qualification condition.
noReviewAcceptance: The failed pass stays incomplete and rejected review stays unaccepted. A fresh full five-phase pass and new independent review are required for any reviewed result. No proposed nextTest, product action or further purchase is authorized by historical critique.
